posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Shota Imanaga's 17 whiffs with his splitter tonight against the Marlins are a career high. His previous career best of 15 whiffs off that pitch was done 3 times (2x in 2024, 1x this year) Imanaga gave the Cubs exactly what they needed tonight vs. Miami: 6+ IP, 3 H, 1 R, 0 BB and 4 K on 94 pitches.
posts.jp: 今永昇太は今夜マーリンズ戦でスプリッターの空振りが17個でキャリアハイ。前回最高の15個は3度(2024年2度、今年1度)。今永は6回以上、3安打、1失点、0四球、4奪三振を94球で完遂。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong makes an amazing leaping catch at CF wall to rob Miami's Hernández at least extra bases & possibly a HR. Ball had .800 xBA & a HR in 20 parks. He's also lucky to not hurt his ankle/foot landing on weird padding at the base of the cutout section of the wall by the CF videoboard.
posts.jp: ピート・クロウ・アームストロングがCF壁でジャンプキャッチを決め、ヘルナンデスから最低でも二塁打以上、おそらくHRを奪う。その打球は.800の期待打率と20球場でHRになっていた。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: Sean Keys just launched his 2nd MLB home run of the season, his 30th between all levels (AA, AAA, MLB). The #BlueJays wanted him to hit breaking balls when he came back, and he did this on a curveball down and in. Great swing.
posts.jp: ショーン・キースがシーズン2本目のMLB本塁打。全レベル通算30本目(AAA、AA、MLB)。ブルージェイズは彼の復帰時に低めのカーブを打つよう求めていた。素晴らしいスイング。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays win, 9-2. Another great performance from an offence that’s turning it around lately. They’re back to .500 (71-71)
posts.jp: ブルージェイズが9-2で勝利。最近調子を上げている攻撃の好パフォーマンス。彼らは五分（71-71）に戻った。

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Final: Guardians 4, Tigers 3 in 10 innings Travis Bazzana walk-off single, after he belted a game-tying 2-run homer in the eighth
posts.jp: ガーディアンズ4-3タイガース(10回)。トラビス・バザナがサヨナラシングル。8回に同点の2ラン本塁打を打っていた。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Aidan Miller, the Phillies' top prospect who has been sidelined all season by a back injury, will play shortstop at Low-A Clearwater on Saturday. More: www.nytimes.com/athletic/756...
posts.jp: フィリーズのトップ見込み選手エイダン・ミラーは背中の負傷でシーズン中盤を欠場。土曜日にローAクリアウォーターでショートを守る予定。
